title: Design System: Alejandra Lazzarano · Gestión de obras sociales

display.purpose: The headline as the 'Práctica solicitada' field value; uppercase, balanced, one per surface. Hyphenates and breaks long words so enlarged text never scrolls sideways.

headline.purpose: Heads of each ruled part; optional sentence-case subtitle at 0.5em, 600, width 85%, Form Ink Soft.

title.purpose: Item heads inside a field row (numbered circuit steps).

body.purpose: Every value typed into the form: field values, list items, table cells, captions, the form number. Max 62ch, carbon offset text-shadow.

body-print.purpose: Base body text (1.0625rem, follows the reader's text-size setting), nav, links and footer in the print face.

label.purpose: Boxed uppercase form labels and ledger column heads.

shadows.name: sheet-on-copy
shadows.purpose: The original sheet resting on the pink duplicate.

shadows.name: triplicate-beneath
shadows.purpose: The celeste copy offset and rotated 0.5deg beneath the sheet.

shadows.name: laid-print
shadows.purpose: The passport photo print laid on the sheet, tinted like the sheet's own shadow.

shadows.name: carbon-offset
shadows.purpose: Faint carbon offset behind typed values only.

shadows.name: carbon-ghost
shadows.purpose: The stamp's carbon ghost on the pink duplicate, behind the sheet and the celeste copy.

motion.name: stamp-fall
motion.purpose: Stamp coming down from 1.65x (1.18x on re-strike) with 5px blur.

motion.name: stamp-spring
motion.value: 460ms underdamped spring (4.2Hz, damping 0.42, kick -2.4), sampled at 60fps via Web Animations API
motion.purpose: Rubber squashing past 1 and settling after contact.

motion.name: ink-fill
motion.value: 520ms ease-out cubic on the ink-mask alpha threshold (1.25 to 2.1)
motion.purpose: Patchy ink at contact filling in.

motion.name: contact-dip
motion.purpose: The button takes the hit at contact.

motion.name: stamp-lift
motion.purpose: Stamp lifts (-5px, 1.035, 0.78 opacity) while the button is hovered (hover-capable devices only) or keyboard-focused.

motion.name: ghost-fade
motion.value: 700ms ease-out, opacity 0 to 0.34, starting at contact (after the 190ms fall)
motion.purpose: The strike's carbon ghost appearing on the pink duplicate.

motion.name: pre-paint
motion.purpose: Stamp and ghost held at opacity 0 until they strike (.struck), so they never flash.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Stamp (static at -9deg) and its ghost visible; no strike, lift, fade, transitions or smooth scroll.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action, in form ink; takes the stamp's violet on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-block; background: #1f2a5a; color: #fcfcfb; text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--f-print), Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 80%; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.12rem; letter-spacing: 0.01em; padding: 15px 22px; border-radius: 3px; transition: background-color 0.2s ease-out, transform 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #46307d; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #5b3f9e; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.description: Secondary mail route under the primary button.

components.name: Header Strip
components.description: Printed form title, form number typed in pink, section nav.
components.html:

RechazosContacto
components.css: .ds-strip { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px 24px; padding: 14px 32px; background: #1f2a5a; color: #fcfcfb; font-family: var(--f-print), Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-strip-title { margin: 0; font-stretch: 75%; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-size: 1.05rem; } .ds-strip-no { white-space: nowrap; font-family: var(--f-type), 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; margin-left: 0.5em; color: #f3c4cf; } .ds-strip-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px 20px; } .ds-strip-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; font-stretch: 85%; font-weight: 550; font-size: 0.95rem; padding: 4px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-strip-nav a:hover { border-bottom-color: currentColor; } .ds-strip-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f3c4cf; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Field Row
components.description: The grammar of the system: boxed printed label beside a typed value, ruled underneath.
components.html:
Diagnóstico

Prestaciones rechazadas, cobros que llegan tarde y horas perdidas con papeles.
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 9.5rem minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 16px; align-items: start; padding: 16px 32px; border-bottom: 1px solid #1f2a5a; background: #fcfcfb; } .ds-label { justify-self: start; border: 1px solid #1f2a5a; padding: 3px 7px 2px; font-family: var(--f-print), Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 70%; font-weight: 650; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; font-size: 0.74rem; line-height: 1.3; color: #1f2a5a; } .ds-typed { margin: 0; font-family: var(--f-type), 'Courier Prime', monospace; color: #1a1a1a; font-size: 1.06rem; line-height: 1.45; text-shadow: 0.7px 0.5px 0 rgb(31 42 90 / 0.16); max-width: 62ch; }

components.name: Check List
components.description: Typed items, each with a square box holding a typed X; dotted sub-rules.
components.html:
• Falta de autorización previa
  • Orden vencida o mal confeccionada
components.css: .ds-checks { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; max-width: 640px; } .ds-checks li { display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: center; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px dotted #4a5480; font-family: var(--f-type), 'Courier Prime', monospace; color: #1a1a1a; font-size: 1.04rem; } .ds-checks li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-box { flex: none; width: 20px; height: 20px; border: 1.5px solid #1f2a5a; position: relative; } .ds-box::before, .ds-box::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 15px; height: 2px; background: #1a1a1a; } .ds-box::before { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(45deg); } .ds-box::after { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-45deg); }

components.name: AUTORIZADO Stamp
components.description: Signature: the violet rubber stamp over the primary button (static snapshot; the strike runs in app/stamp.tsx).
components.html: Escribime por WhatsApp
components.css: .ds-stamped { position: relative; padding-top: 74px; display: inline-block; } .ds-stamp { position: absolute; z-index: 1; width: 210px; top: 0; left: 34px; color: #5b3f9e; opacity: 0.9; transform: rotate(-9deg); pointer-events: none; transition: translate 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), scale 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), opacity 0.25s ease-out; } .ds-stamp-word { font-family: var(--f-print), Archivo, sans-serif; font-stretch: 70%; font-weight: 800; font-size: 56px; } .ds-stamp-btn { display: inline-block; background: #1f2a5a; color: #fcfcfb; text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--f-print), Archivo, sans-serif; font-stretch: 80%; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.12rem; padding: 15px 22px; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-stamp-btn:hover { background: #46307d; } .ds-stamped:has(.ds-stamp-btn:focus-visible) .ds-stamp { translate: 0 -5px; scale: 1.035; opacity: 0.78; } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-stamped:has(.ds-stamp-btn:hover) .ds-stamp { translate: 0 -5px; scale: 1.035; opacity: 0.78; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-stamp { transition: none; } .ds-stamped:has(.ds-stamp-btn:hover, .ds-stamp-btn:focus-visible) .ds-stamp { translate: none; scale: none; } }

components.name: Talón Perforation
components.description: The talón's tear line: punched holes showing the pink copy, with die-cut notches at both sheet edges.
components.html: Talón para el prestador
components.css: .ds-talon-wrap { background: #f3c4cf; padding: 24px; } .ds-talon { position: relative; background: color-mix(in srgb, #bfd7ea 30%, #fcfcfb); padding: 40px 32px 18px; } .ds-talon::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 22px; right: 22px; top: -4px; height: 8px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 4px 4px, #f3c4cf 2.3px, rgb(110 40 70 / 0.45) 2.9px, transparent 3.5px) 0 0 / 11px 8px repeat-x; } .ds-talon::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -10px; right: -10px; top: -10px; height: 20px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 10px 10px, #f3c4cf 9.5px, transparent 10px) left / 20px 20px no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle at 10px 10px, #f3c4cf 9.5px, transparent 10px) right / 20px 20px no-repeat; pointer-events: none; } .ds-talon-head { margin: 0; font-family: var(--f-print), Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 65%; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 2rem; line-height: 0.98; color: #1f2a5a; }

narrative.overview:
The whole surface is one administrative form: an orden de prestación printed in a single deep blue-black form ink on a white original, laid over its pink carbon duplicate with the celeste triplicate peeking out beneath. Every piece of content is a field on that form: a boxed, condensed, uppercase printed label on the left, and the value typed in beside it in a typewriter face. Sections are further ruled parts of the same order, and the contact block is the talón, separated by a row of punched holes.

Density is that of a real form: ruled rows, hairline and double-weight rules, tight label column, no floating cards. Color carries meaning by material, not by decoration: form ink is everything pre-printed, carbon black is everything typed, violet is the one rubber stamp. The stamp is the single authored motion moment; it strikes the authorization box once, unevenly inked, and lands across the primary action; on wide screens the same strike shows through faintly on the pink copy past the sheet's edge.
keyCharacteristics: One sheet on a pink carbon copy, celeste triplicate offset beneath it; the pink always frames the sheet.
Two voices only: condensed printed grotesk (Archivo, width axis) for what the form prints; Courier Prime for what is typed in.
Label + value field rows on a ruled grid are the grammar of every section.
Square, ruled geometry; the only rounding is 3px on actionable controls (2px on the focus ring).
One violet rubber stamp, one strike, with per-visit angle and ink pattern, carried through as a carbon ghost onto the duplicate.

rules.name: The Material Ink Rule
rules.body: A color names a material, not a mood: print is Form Ink, typed values are Carbon Type, the stamp is Sello Violet, paper is one of the three copies. A new element takes the ink of what it would physically be on the form.

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: Sello Violet appears as a full mark exactly once per surface: the AUTORIZADO stamp. Its only echo is that same strike carried through as a faint carbon ghost onto the pink duplicate; it is the same impression, not a second stamp. Everywhere else violet is limited to interaction states (focus, selection, hover).

rules.name: The Typed-Value Rule
rules.body: Courier Prime is for content the form receives (values, list items, table cells, captions, the form number), never for printed headings, labels, buttons or navigation.

rules.name: The Narrower-Is-Louder Rule
rules.body: Scale up with font-stretch toward 62%, not with extra weight beyond 800.

rules.name: The Paper-Only Depth Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong to physical sheets and prints. Controls, rows and boxes inside the form are flat; they are separated by rules.

dos: Do express new content as field rows: a boxed printed label beside a typed value on the 9.5rem label grid.
Do separate with rules (1px rows, 2px parts, dotted sub-items, punched perforation), never with cards or gaps alone.
Do set every typed value in Courier Prime Carbon Type with the faint carbon offset, max 62ch.
Do scale printed headings by narrowing the width axis (62–78%) at weight 750–800.
Do keep Sello Violet to the single stamp plus focus, selection and hover states.
Do keep the stamp static and fully visible under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep the pink duplicate visible around the sheet at every width.
Do gate hover-only effects behind a hover-capable pointer, and give text links a 44px tap area under a coarse pointer.
donts: Don't set headings, labels, buttons or navigation in the typewriter face.
Don't add a second stamp or a second full violet mark to a surface; the carbon ghost is the one strike carried through, not a new mark.
Don't round containers, label boxes or check boxes; 3px belongs to actionable controls only.
Don't put shadows on anything that is not a physical sheet or print laid on the form.
Don't introduce colors outside the three inks and three paper copies.
